# hetznerrobot_wake_on_lan (Resource)

Sends a Wake on LAN packet to a dedicated server — once on creation, and again whenever `triggers` change. The server must support it (`hetznerrobot_server.wol`). Reading and destroying the resource do nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Wakes server 321 on creation and whenever the triggers change.
resource "hetznerrobot_wake_on_lan" "wake" {
  server_number = 321
  triggers = {
    date = "2026-10-12"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Server to wake.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; changing any of them runs the action again (the resource is replaced).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Records the server number without sending anything.
tofu import hetznerrobot_wake_on_lan.wake 321
```
